coordinate_system: RH_Y_UP_Z_FORWARD rest world (bundle); converted from HumanoidAlpha MuJoCo Z-up as (x, z, -y)
source: HumanoidAlpha physics/model/humanoid_alpha.xml joint axes and physics/anatomical_ranges.json (ENGINEERING priors, needs external validation)

elbow.note: Hinge. Xandra's rest elbow is already bent; flexion is measured from a straight arm, not from rest as in HumanoidAlpha.

forearm_roll.note: Pronation/supination about the forearm axis, relative to the rest forearm. Not modelled in HumanoidAlpha; anatomical prior.

wrist.note: Two hinges relative to the rest hand; no axial wrist roll.

binding: registered skeleton (profile files rig.npz); any clothing asset with this rig
